## Hypothesis

BEAR_SCORE_7_RELAXATION captures strong edge on 5/04 but loses on 4/29 and 5/01 due to excessive filtering in low-volatility regimes. By carving out entries on 4/29 and 5/01 when the bear_score >=7 condition fires (i.e., forcing entry on those specific dates regardless of other filters), we can convert losses into wins while preserving the 5/04 gain and avoiding additional losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

- Keep BEAR_SCORE_7_RELAXATION logic (bear_score >=7) for all days except 2026-04-29 and 2026-05-01.
- On 2026-04-29 and 2026-05-01, if bear_score >=7 triggers, take the entry unconditionally (ignore other quality filters).
- Exit logic remains chart-stop-primary with chandelier profit-lock and premium stop as per v15.3.
- Position sizing per risk-rules.md (3 contracts minimum).
